amendment: Adds predeclared QCLOUD initial-contrast signal metrics; v1 RMS plot calculations and panels are unchanged.
limits: RMS panels are descriptive response plots, not observation scores.
No post-response mask, timestamp, or threshold selection is performed.
QCLOUD signal metrics reuse the frozen PR94 projection/cosine helper with the arm's own initial contrast; no Pearson skill claim is made.
Pressure, geopotential, W, and QCLOUD keep their native fields/units; no causal or forecast-skill claim is inferred.

qc_signal_preservation.baseline_definition: each arm's 0-second QCLOUD minus actual OFF QCLOUD, fixed separately on each region
qc_signal_preservation.claim_limit: fixed-support pattern diagnostics only; not Pearson correlation, observation skill, or forecast improvement
qc_signal_preservation.zero_baseline_behavior: existing helper reports cosine/projection as null (N/A); no replacement statistic is substituted.

source_scope: Actual saved host arrays at predeclared 0..600 seconds, 60s cadence; H/C/P/N five-arm values preserved from the immutable PR102 reader output and independently checked against receipt-bound arrays; A−OFF and A−P/N/H calculated from native history arrays.
